The wording of the 15 TSRQ items is fully recoverable and the extraction was otherwise trivial -- the live IRW `item` values ARE the source spreadsheet's own column headers verbatim (e.g. '(TSRQ_1) Because I felt that I wanted to take responsibility for my own health.'), data/kushnir2017_smoking_cessation.py melts them unrenamed, and the deposit (doi:10.7910/DVN/8LBLYS, 'Unassisted Smoking Cessation MINIMAL ANONYMIZED DATASET.xlsx') is CC0 1.0. The block is on the INSTRUMENT, not the deposit. The Treatment Self-Regulation Questionnaire is an SDT instrument distributed by the Center for Self-Determination Theory, whose questionnaires page states: "You are welcome to use the instruments for academic (non-commercial) research projects. However, you may not use any of them for any commercial purposes without written permission to do so from the Center for Self-Determination Theory." and "All questionnaires on this web site, developed for research on self-determination theory, are copyrighted." (https://selfdeterminationtheory.org/questionnaires/, fetched 2026-09-08; the HCSDTQ page https://selfdeterminationtheory.org/health-care-self-determination-theory-questionnaire/ , which distributes the TSRQ and names its four health-behaviour versions including smoking cessation, repeats it as "All academic use is permitted, but you must obtain permission from the Center for Self-Determination Theory for commercial use."). That is a stated use restriction attached to the instrument by its rights holder -- the same free-but-restricted shape as hexaco.org -- so the 2026-09-05 HEXACO ruling (irw#1945, 'err on the side of not having things. so do not host') applies, and the 2026-09-06 wording_rights retirement (irw#1955) confirms that an open source deposit no longer rescues it: ECR-12, PSS-10, IRI, AAQ-II, the Flourishing Scale and SHS were all withdrawn on exactly this shape despite their wording having come from openly licensed deposits. If TSRQ blocks, BFI arguably does too, and vice versa -- flagging for Ben rather than acting on a sibling table outside this agent's scope.
